project: VASA fragrance collection — product reveal studio plates
purpose: Four separate luxury commercial-photography background plates for compositing supplied, real VASA bottle cutouts. Each plate is a 4:5 portrait and must reserve the same central product-safe zone; it is not a finished bottle image.

master_art_direction.campaign_idea: A quiet, modern Indian luxury fragrance campaign photographed as physical studio still life. The image is the moment just before the bottle is placed: material, light and air give each scent a precise emotional setting without becoming a scene or illustration.
master_art_direction.visual_language: High-end beauty advertising photographed in a real studio with a restrained set build. Tactile materials, controlled tonal transitions, credible reflections and contact-shadow potential. The campaign should feel premium, contemporary and editorial, with the discipline of a fragrance house rather than a decorative lifestyle brand.
master_art_direction.shared_set_system: Use one vertical tabletop-to-backdrop cyclorama construction, viewed near eye level. The product position remains identical in every frame. Distinction comes only from the backdrop finish, surface material, palette and light character. Keep every set physically plausible and sparse.
master_art_direction.product_compositing_rule: Do not generate any perfume bottle, cap, box, label, logo, typography, lettering, symbol or packaging. The supplied real bottle cutout will be composited later. Leave the central product-safe zone clear, evenly usable and free from props, seams, high-contrast reflections, cast shadows, haze and hard texture crossings.

safe_zone.coordinate_system: Percentages of the final 4:5 frame; x runs left to right and y runs top to bottom.
safe_zone.base_contact_area: x: 36–64%, y: 78–88%; retain a quiet, physically plausible tabletop plane here so a natural bottle contact shadow can be added in post.
safe_zone.copy_margin: Keep the upper 10% and outer 8% of the frame calm enough for optional responsive cropping; no baked text anywhere.

consistent_capture.camera: 100 MP medium-format digital camera on tripod, portrait orientation, ISO 100, tethered studio capture
consistent_capture.lens_and_view: 80 mm equivalent lens, camera level with a slight 5–8 degree downward angle, f/8 to f/11; 1/125 s flash sync
consistent_capture.finish: Natural, neutral commercial retouching; realistic micro-contrast; restrained analogue-like grain only; no heavy vignette or filter
consistent_capture.lighting_principle: One dominant shaped key with controlled fill and flags. Light must describe real material and leave a believable grounding plane for the later bottle, never create a theatrical beam or fantasy atmosphere.

non_negotiables: Generate four separate images, never a collage, diptych, contact sheet, website mockup or mood board.
Every output is 4:5 portrait at 2400 × 3000 px or larger, with no crop into the product-safe zone.
No flowers, fruit, spices, ingredients, hands, people, animals, buildings, landscapes or scenery.
No floating objects, smoke, mist, flames, liquid splash, glitter, lens flare, excessive bokeh, surreal light, CGI geometry or ornamental pedestal.
No text, branding, watermarks, readable marks, invented packaging or AI-generated bottle forms.

images.material_direction: A hand-finished cool mineral-plaster sweep meets a honed pale limestone tabletop at a soft horizontal curve. The finish is dry, matte and softly clouded, with only faint real plaster variation around the far edges.

generation_and_delivery_controls.file_recommendation: 16-bit TIFF or PNG master; export a lossless or high-quality WebP derivative only after bottle compositing.
generation_and_delivery_controls.colour_management: Capture and deliver in a wide-gamut working space; convert the final web derivative to sRGB after retouching.
generation_and_delivery_controls.retouching: Remove dust and accidental imperfections that read as defects, but preserve believable plaster, velvet and lacquer texture. Do not introduce artificial gradients or effects.
approval_checklist: The central safe zone matches the prescribed bounds and contains no generated object, lettering, reflection or high-contrast texture.
Each image is recognisably part of one campaign through angle, framing, capture quality and lighting discipline.
Silent Storm reads cool/mineral; Sweetest Stranger reads warm/powdered; Rebel in Velvet reads mulberry/tactile; The Night Lingers reads dark/ambered.
Every background is physically plausible as a real studio set and supports a later real-bottle composite without masking or reconstruction.
